_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "age_years" INTEGER NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "injuries" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "injury_notes" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "coach_personality" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "disclaimer_accepted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "run_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "run_suggestion_keys" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_days" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "label_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "precedes_run_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("precedes_run_day" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_day_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "template_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seconds_per_rep" REAL NOT NULL, "target_reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_hold_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_day_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "rating" TEXT NULL, "pain_reported" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pain_reported" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "hold_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "form_score" REAL NULL, "camera_angle" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rep_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rep_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("counted" IN (0, 1)), "rejection_reason" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "peak_angle" REAL NULL, "range_of_motion" REAL NULL, "form_score" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "form_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rep_index" INTEGER NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "magnitude" REAL NOT NULL, "at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_records" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "achieved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("target_table"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_identity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'this_device', "install_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "claimed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
